slides.heading: for Loops
slides.body: for Loops is part of Definite Iteration. This short lesson gives you a practical Python idea you can understand, try, and reuse in simple programs.

slides.heading: Core Idea: for Loops
slides.body: A for loop repeats code for each value in a sequence. It is helpful when you know what collection or range you want to process.

slides.heading: Real-World Analogy
slides.body: A for loop is like checking each name on an attendance list, one name at a time.

annotations.note: This line starts a loop that processes each value in a sequence.
This line displays a value or message on the screen.

slides.heading: Key Rule
slides.body: Use for loops when you want to repeat through a known range or sequence.

slides.heading: Try It Yourself!
slides.prompt: Use a for loop to print numbers from range(3).
slides.hint: Use for number in range(3): then indent print(number).
